config_dir.description: Override default Cantata config directory (e.g., /etc/cantata). If empty, uses built-in default.

test_root.description: Root directory containing test projects, source files, and output directories.

test_targets.description: List of target platforms, each in format 'name:compiler:toolchain:arch'. Example: 'arm-none-eabi-gcc:GNU:arm-gcc:ARM_Cortex-M4'.

coverage_ruleset.description: Code coverage rule set. Valid values: 'MC/DC', 'DC', 'C0', 'C1', 'C2'. Used for compliance with safety standards.

auto_test_enabled.description: Enable or disable AutoTest, which automatically generates test vectors.

auto_test_max_cases.description: Maximum number of test cases AutoTest may generate per function. 0 = unlimited.

wrapper_lib.description: Path to Cantata wrapper library (e.g., /opt/cantata/lib/cantata_wrapper.so) for call interception.

report_output_dir.description: Directory to write test reports, coverage reports, and diagnostics.

requirements_map_file.description: Path to requirements traceability file (e.g., Excel, ReqIF). Enables bidirectional traceability.

metrics_enabled.description: Enable collection of source code metrics (e.g., Halstead volume, cyclomatic complexity).
